court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
case_name: A.Sivakumar vs The Director on 4 June, 2019

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: A.Sivakumar (Petitioner in WP(MD)No.12238 of 2018), J.Selvin Thiyagarajan (Petitioner in WP(MD)No.15581 of 2018), V.Nadesh (Petitioner in WP(MD)No.24229 of 2018)
parties.respondent_defendant: The Director, Dr.Ambedkar Foundation, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, 15, Janpath, New Delhi – 110 001, The Secretary to Government, Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu, State Secretariat, Chennai – 600 009

facts_of_case: Petitioners belong to Hindu Pallan community. They got married to non-scheduled caste individuals. Marriage is an intercaste marriage. Petitioners claim relief under Dr.Ambedkar Scheme for Social Integration through Inter-Caste Marriages.

legal_principles.principle: The primary and foremost task of a court in interpreting a statute is to ascertain the intention of the legislature, actual or imputed.
legal_principles.held: Having ascertained the intention, the Court must then strive to so interpret the statute as to promote and advance the object and purpose of the enactment.
cited_cases: M/s Girdhari Lal & Sons vs. Balbir Nath Mathur and others, [1986]1SCR383
Shubhi Khandelwal vs. University of Delhi and Ors

legal_principles.principle: The court's powers to interpret the provisions in order to gather the legislative intention always remain unimpaired.
legal_principles.held: Irrespective of the words used in the enactment, the court's powers to interpret the provisions in order to gather the legislative intention always remain unimpaired.
cited_cases: M/s Girdhari Lal & Sons vs. Balbir Nath Mathur and others, [1986]1SCR383
Shubhi Khandelwal vs. University of Delhi and Ors

outcome.final_order: Direct the 1st respondent to make payment of Rs.2.50 lakhs to the petitioners under Dr.Ambedkar Scheme for Social Integration through Inter-Caste Marriages together with interest at the rate of 12% p.a.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for judicial review of government decision
advising on inter-caste marriage and social integration schemes
